captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a medical room air purifier with a light gray rectangular main housing mounted on a dark gray pedestal stand with a wide flat base. The top features a hinged HEPA access lid with a blue-green rectangular handle, articulated to open upwards via a rear revolute hinge. On one side, a blue pre-filter panel with vertical slot vents and a central black handle is mounted on horizontal guide rails, designed to slide outward prismatically.
captions.instruction: Generate a medical room air purifier model in CadQuery. The model should feature a rectangular main housing on a sturdy pedestal stand, an articulated top HEPA access lid that opens via a revolute hinge at the rear, and a side-mounted pre-filter panel with vertical air vents and a handle that slides out prismatically.
captions.factory: The code constructs the air purifier using three main parts. The base and main housing are built from Box and Cylinder primitives representing the pedestal, bottom platform, and main vertical cabinet. The top HEPA lid is modeled as a flat box with a cylindrical hinge at the rear edge and a small colored handle plate, connected to the base via a revolute joint. The pre-filter panel is constructed as a thin box with vertical slot cutouts and a central handle grip, attached to the main housing via a prismatic joint that allows it to slide along the side rails.
